title: Invites
createError: Could not create the invite. Check your connection and try again.
shownOnce: This link is shown only now: the server keeps only its hash and cannot show it again. Each link registers one member.
loadError: Could not load the invites. Check your connection and try again.
revokeError: Could not revoke the invite. Reload and try again.

errors.notAllowed: You cannot invite right now. Reload the page to see why.
errors.limit_one: You can have at most {{count}} active invite. Revoke it, or wait until it is used or expires.
errors.limit_other: You can have at most {{count}} active invites. Revoke one, or wait until one is used or expires.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again later.

me.maintainer: As a maintainer you can invite new members at any time, and see and revoke every invite on the admin page.
me.loadError: Could not check whether you can invite. Check your connection and try again.
me.disabled: A maintainer has turned off your invite permission. You can still see and revoke your own invites.
me.cooldown_one: New members wait a while before they can invite: {{count}} day left, you can invite from {{date}}.
me.cooldown_other: New members wait a while before they can invite: {{count}} days left, you can invite from {{date}}.
me.limitReached_one: You have {{count}} active invite, the most you can have. Revoke it, or wait until it is used or expires.
me.limitReached_other: You have {{count}} active invites, the most you can have. Revoke one, or wait until one is used or expires.
me.allowed_one: You can invite new members: each link registers one person, and you can have {{count}} active invite at a time (now {{active}}). The people you invite are recorded as invited by you.
me.allowed_other: You can invite new members: each link registers one person, and you can have up to {{count}} active invites at a time (now {{active}}). The people you invite are recorded as invited by you.
